title: Make the catalogue's sitemap discoverable despite the Pages subpath
problem: The catalogue is served at https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/. Crawlers read robots.txt only at the host root (https://duncan-haywood.github.io/robots.txt, the owner's user Pages site), so the Sitemap: line the build publishes is never seen and no engine can list the catalogue's pages. IndexNow announcements reach Bing and Yandex only; Google does not take part. Crawling is allowed; enumeration of 1,200+ venture pages is lost.
evidence: python3 platform/ci/indexnow_state.py on 2026-10-16: last announcement run 38842485378 accepted; Google does not participate
2026-10-24: https://duncan-haywood.github.io/robots.txt returns 404; no google-site-verification or msvalidate tag anywhere in the tree; pages_state.py indexing = subpath-robots
change: Cheapest first, all owner steps because they create a repository or verify a property in the owner's name: (1) create the repository Duncan-Haywood/duncan-haywood.github.io with Pages on and a robots.txt of two lines: 'User-agent: *' and 'Sitemap: https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/sitemap.xml' (if the repo exists, edit its robots.txt and make sure it does not Disallow the subpath); (2) submit sitemap.xml in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools; (3) longer term, a custom domain so the site sits at an origin root (pages-custom-domain ask). Agent half: once (1) is live, make pages_state.py read the root robots.txt and report the Sitemap line as found. For (2): a URL-prefix property for https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ verifies with an HTML file or meta tag and needs no custom domain; give the token to a session and it adds it to the pages build. Bing Webmaster Tools can import the Google property, and Bing's index also feeds ChatGPT search and Copilot.
metric: pages_state.py indexing verdict; pages indexed per Search Console once (2) is done
source: Owner review of repo standards in a Claude Code session, 2026-10-16
